about_the_game:
Developed with Unreal Engine and powered by state-of-the-art rendering technologies, REDACT delivers a gritty, immersive tactical shooter experience that blurs the line between video games and reality — giving players the most authentic and realistic experience possible.

REDACT is a hyper-realistic bodycam first-person shooter where players take on the role of an elite operator completing high-risk tactical missions. With immersive audio, limited HUD, realistic gunplay, and a grounded single-player and multiplayer experience, the game challenges players to use real-world tactics, make split-second decisions, and survive intense urban combat scenarios.

CORE FEATURES

Free-Aiming System with No Crosshair
Master a raw aiming system that offers no aim assist, no crosshair — just your skill, your weapon, and pure focus.

Minimalist and Tactical Gunplay
No arcade chaos — every bullet counts. Execute your plans with caution in a “die and retry” structure that punishes carelessness and rewards precision.

Single-Player and Multiplayer Missions
Play intense solo operations or join forces in cooperative tactical missions where coordination is key and failure is unforgiving.

Bodycam-Style Immersion
Experience the game through a body-mounted camera with realistic head and weapon movement, aggressive motion effects, and zero UI distractions — as close to real footage as it gets.

Built in Unreal Engine Using Modern Tech
Designed with the latest features of Unreal Engine to deliver photorealistic visuals, immersive audio, and responsive gameplay for the most grounded experience possible.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G, Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X, Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB)
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

short_description: REDACT is a realistic bodycam first-person shooter where you complete tactical missions using real-world strategies, limited resources, and immersive audio in both single-player and multiplayer modes.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
